# wsnap v0.1.0-alpha.1

First public preview of workspace snapshots and recovery for Kubernetes Pods
and agent-sandbox Sandboxes. The API is `wsnap.dev/v1alpha1` and may change.

## Included

- Kopia, restic, and exec snapshot engines; S3-compatible, GCS, Azure Blob,
  and filesystem backends.
- Sidecar and worker execution, scheduled and request-driven snapshots, final
  snapshots on graceful shutdown, cold restore, rollback, and fork.
- PVC, generic ephemeral volume, and `emptyDir` handling. Released PV rescue
  runs only while the PV remains accessible; rescue PVCs bind to the original
  claim and PV identity.
- Scoped credentials, namespace-bound Secret access, admission checks, TLS,
  and an example policy for reviewed StorageClasses and PVC quotas.
- Digest-pinned linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 images in the attached
  `install.yaml`.

## Verification and limits

Go, race, vulnerability, and Kubernetes E2E checks run in CI. The E2E suite
covers Kubernetes 1.37 and the volume and worker paths on 1.30, including
failure injection and install/uninstall. Storage backends are tested with
MinIO, SeaweedFS, fake-gcs-server, and Azurite. **Real AWS, GCP, and Azure
conformance has not run** because dedicated test accounts are not configured.
There is no prior release from which to test an upgrade.

A lost PV or node can lose writes made after the last completed snapshot.
Set the snapshot interval to the amount of work you can afford to lose, and
pilot this alpha with non-critical workloads before wider deployment.

See [operations](https://chrisyifanjin.github.io/wsnap/operations/) for
installation, repository setup, storage policy, and uninstall instructions.
